datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics and the limitations of the sources used to implement those results.

lineage.description: UNOSAT derived post-event wind speed exposure zones from satellite observations of Hurricane Matthew (October 2016), classified into three threshold categories (60, 90, 120 km/h) and intersected with census population data at the administrative division level to quantify population exposure.

sources.name: UN Operational Satellite Applications Programme (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite-derived wind speed zones from Hurricane Matthew mapped to administrative boundaries in Jamaica
